emails.subject: URGENT Query: DNL593 Study - IP Accountability Discrepancy at Site 701
emails.body:
Hi Samantha,

Hope you are well.

During our routine monthly investigational product (IP) accountability check for the DNL593 study today, we identified a discrepancy.

Our physical count shows 14 vials of DNL593 (active drug), but our accountability logs indicate we should have 15 vials on hand. The placebo count is accurate. We have double-checked all dispensing records, patient visit logs, and destruction records from the past month and cannot account for the missing vial.

Attached is a scanned copy of our most recent accountability log for your review.

Please advise on the immediate next steps and any required documentation we need to complete on our end.

Best regards,

Dr. Alan Turing, RPh
Lead Pharmacist
University Health Research Center
Site 701

emails.subject: Re: URGENT Query: DNL593 Study - IP Accountability Discrepancy at Site 701
emails.body:
Hi Dr. Turing,

Thank you for your prompt notification and for providing the accountability log. I have received it and am escalating this to the study team for immediate review.

As a first step, please quarantine all remaining DNL593 and placebo stock for this study until we have a resolution. Please do not dispense any further IP.

Could you please also prepare a brief deviation note in the site file detailing the discovery of this discrepancy? I will follow up by the end of the day with a formal IP Discrepancy Form for you to complete and any further instructions from the team.

We will work with you to resolve this as quickly as possible.

Best,

Samantha Carter
Clinical Research Associate
PharmaTech Inc.

emails.subject: Re: URGENT Query: DNL593 Study - IP Accountability Discrepancy at Site 701
emails.body:
Hi Samantha,

Thank you for the clear instructions. We have quarantined all study IP as requested and will prepare the deviation note.

We will await the IP Discrepancy Form and your further guidance.

Regards,

Dr. Alan Turing, RPh
Lead Pharmacist
University Health Research Center
Site 701

description: A query from a site pharmacist about discrepancies found during the monthly investigational product accountability check for DNL593 and placebo.
